zufft

zufft computes fast Fourier, cosine and sine transforms in R. It bundles the BSD-licensed FFT code of ducc0, the same subset and commit that SciPy uses, so it needs no system FFTW library and carries no GPL code.

Its goals, in order:

  1. Replace fftwtools without FFTW. Install with install.packages() alone, under a permissive licence.
  2. Perform like fftwtools. Within 1.5 times its speed everywhere, and faster on prime lengths, many simultaneous transforms and threads.
  3. An easy, familiar API. Function names a fftwtools user recognises, with the conventions of scipy.fft for axes, normalisation, cosine and sine transforms, and threads.

Status (2026-10-13): not yet usable. The package is being built stage by stage; see the roadmap and the v0.1.0 issue.

Installation

You can install the development version of zufft from GitHub with:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("pedrobtz/zufft")
